cursor-mcpoison.description: Benign file viewer — this approved name now runs arbitrary code after config tampering

_comment: CVE-2025-54136: MCPoison — approved server name, command silently changed after approval. Original was harmless 'echo Hello world!'. The issue is that Cursor only checks server NAME not command/args on re-approval. Detection: MCP05 (cmd.exe injection), MCP07 (no transport/auth), MCP02 (malware.bat in args).
